I'm a 19 year old college student and I work at a Whataburger around Dallas, Texas (for my fellow shitlords and shitladies who live outside of the American Southwest, Whataburger is like McDiabeetus but waaaay unhealthier, yes I hate my job). So anyways, I am a cook at the establishment (being a cook at this place helped me go vegetarian) and when I work on the drive-thru grill we get the headsets so we can prepare what I'm hesitant to call food ahead of time. So anyways, it can get boring at times and I play a game where I try to guess what the customer looks like by the sound of their voice and their order and then I glance outside the window to see if I'm right. The first time I played this I got one lady got really excited when she was ordering, so she ordered a Monterrey Jack Melt with bacon and avocado whatasized it and a kids meal. The sounds this woman made while she ordered it were hysterical, she ran out of breath, slobbered, and got really excited. I immediately thought "lardshit" and when Lardshit made her way to the window to pay I glanced over to see a massive guess the gender blob with her little blobkid sitting shotgun. When she pulled away I started laughing really hard. My coworkers looked at me and I just told them I remembered a joke. I've been doing this a lot at work lately and I've gotten really good at it.

TL;DR: I work at a fast food joint, and I've gotten good at distinguishing lardshits by the orders they make and how they sound over the drive-thru.

Fireworks Safety Video Series, Just a Reminder to Be Safe This Fourth

Some important reminders:

  • Alcohol and fireworks don't mix.
  • The small fireworks can be dangerous as well. People got blind by those little tiny bottle rockets.
  • Don't put bottle rockets in a bottle. They can easily fall over. use a pipe, and bury that 1/2 in sand.
  • Cakeboxes that are longer than they're wide will most likely tip over. Use bricks or anything else heavy to stabilize them. Some have unfolding triangles underneath them. use those. to be safe, do this to all cakesboxes.
  • be cautious when using a lighter. the flame can ignite the fuse halfway rather than at the start. rather use a slow burning fuse.
  • NEVER ever put your head above fireworks.
  • If you're going to shoot shells (above 3"), make sure how to use them:

1: Always use the right size mortar! If you put a 3" shell in a 4" mortar it will go a lot lower, which can be very dangerous 2: Make sure the croud is at a safe distance 3: Usually shells have quickfise, meaning they will lauch when you light the fuse. if you're shooting manually always use some green fuse (which burns slower) to attach to the quickfuse. green visco fuse burns around 1 sec/cm so make sure it's long enough 4: if you shoot with only one mortar, make sure to let it cool down and clean it after every shot. After a while a black sticky mess will build up when you don't clean which can jam the shell. If you notice that you have to push the shell in the mortar rather than lowering it in it means the mortar is dirty. 5: Make sure your mortar is fixed properly. Either bury it 1/2 in the ground, or build a rack from wood and fix that with sand bags. 6:make sure the mortar is the right material. NEVER use PVC!!! Buy one that's made out of fiberglass. usuing the wrong material is extremely dangerous. PVC for instance will fragment in little pieces when the shell explodes inside the tube, resulting in very dangerous situations. 7: inspect the shells before you shoot. if you see any damage, just don;t shoot that one.

Just a few tips!
